members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs patch src/mcp/shared/exceptions.py to fix pickling of MCPError-family exceptions, specifically the crash reconstructing UrlElicitationRequiredError (constructor signature mismatch vs. the default Exception.__reduce_ex__ behavior, tracked as #2431). #2478 takes a base-class approach: adds a module-level `_restore_mcp_error` dispatcher that special-cases UrlElicitationRequiredError (via `.from_error`) and falls back to `.from_error_data` for everything else, plus un-marks the `data` property as untested. #2555 takes a subclass-local approach: adds `__reduce__` directly on UrlElicitationRequiredError returning `(self.__class__, (self._elicitations, self.message))`, with a docstring citing the exact `TypeError: takes from 2 to 3 positional arguments but 4 were given` and closing #2431 explicitly. Both changes target the same reconstruction problem for the same class in the same file - merging both would leave duplicate/conflicting reconstruction logic (the subclass's own `__reduce__` from #2555 takes precedence at pickle time over any base-class dispatch from #2478, making #2478's UrlElicitationRequiredError branch dead code). (2 PRs)

members.title: fix: don't send a response for cancelled requests
members.author: Zelys-DFKH
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2514: RequestResponder.cancel() in src/mcp/shared/session.py incorrectly sent a JSON-RPC error response when a request was cancelled, violating the spec rule that a receiver must not send any response for a cancelled request. clusters.pick_reason: #3221 introduces a type-preserving routing key (_request_stream_key) that keys on 'i:'/'s:' prefix plus value, so integer id 1 and string id "1" are tracked as distinct in-flight requests. #3063 keys _request_streams with str(request_id), which collapses int 1 and string "1" into the same key — causing a false 409 when they legitimately differ, and it does not guard against a string id colliding with the reserved GET_STREAM_KEY sentinel, both of which #3221 explicitly fixes and documents in code comments.

members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2555: Both PRs patch src/mcp/shared/exceptions.py to fix pickling of MCPError-family exceptions, specifically the crash reconstructing UrlElicitationRequiredError (constructor signature mismatch vs. the default Exception.__reduce_ex__ behavior, tracked as #2431). #2478 takes a base-class approach: adds a module-level `_restore_mcp_error` dispatcher that special-cases UrlElicitationRequiredError (via `.from_error`) and falls back to `.from_error_data` for everything else, plus un-marks the `data` property as untested. #2555 takes a subclass-local approach: adds `__reduce__` directly on UrlElicitationRequiredError returning `(self.__class__, (self._elicitations, self.message))`, with a docstring citing the exact `TypeError: takes from 2 to 3 positional arguments but 4 were given` and closing #2431 explicitly.
